--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective." (report text is present in the prompt; the trace does not question or discard it)
STRATEGY: The parent cooperates initially, tracks opponent defection/cooperation rates and streaks, retaliates to defections, forgives isolated defections when the opponent has been highly cooperative, and occasionally defects when the opponent's cooperation rate is very high (e.g., opp_rate >= 0.75 and n%17==0). The trace simulates the parent and several population strategies (slots 0, 1, 3, 5, 8) to estimate their forgiveness thresholds and exploitable defection rates. It proposes a new adaptive strategy that probes with occasional defections, estimates the opponent's punishment rate, increases defection frequency when the opponent is forgiving, avoids consecutive defections unless the opponent never retaliates, and defects more aggressively in the endgame.

The trace simulates slot 8 (fitness 268.75) and various opponents (always C, slot 1, slot 3, slot 5, slot 8) to design a rewrite. It changes the exploitation branch to defect every 10th round when opp_d==0, keeps slot 8-style core logic for opp_d>0, and adds last-round defection.

Changed by adding a 10% defection rate when opponent has never defected, removing endgame mass defection to avoid retaliation, and simplifying core logic.
